title: Calculation-scope-declaration act payload
description: ADR-0069 Decision 5/9: the non-kernel act that records a workspace-calculation-scope.v1 citizen naming the rule id(s) a workspace's calculation actually composes. Out-of-kernel: the kind is not registered in findings.KERNEL_ACT_KINDS, and the nested citizen is not a kernel-projected fact -- it is never addressable from env.sources or any rule's when/value expression. The nested citizen is the authority; a later declaration at the same (subject_id, tax_year) replaces the prior one in the fold, which can only widen the standing-authorization re-authorization boundary, never replace or narrow it below the entrypoints the run actually executes and publishes.
